name: Garou Sliding Simulator
storyline: In Garou Sliding Simulator, Garou — the relentless Hero Hunter from One-Punch Man — finds himself uncontrollably sliding down a grassy slope. The game turns this meme-worthy animation moment into a light, reflex-driven challenge: as Garou slides, players must guide him to avoid obstacles and maintain momentum. There’s no major plot or combat — the goal is simple survival through the absurd situation of the Garou's infamous slide.
summary: Garou Sliding Simulator is a fan-made, informal game inspired by the humorously animated scene of Garou sliding in the One-Punch Man anime. Players control Garou as he slides across the terrain, aiming to travel as far as possible while avoiding various obstacles. The game is simple, comedic, and focused entirely on the sliding mechanic that became a meme among fans.
